aioInputs.name: vehicleMake
aioInputs.description: Make of the vehicle (Toyota, Honda, Ford, Hyundai, etc.) — battery price varies sharply by OEM

aioInputs.name: vehicleModel
aioInputs.description: Specific model (Prius, Camry Hybrid, Accord Hybrid, Escape Hybrid, Ioniq, etc.) — determines pack size and availability

aioInputs.name: modelYear
aioInputs.description: Model year — affects parts availability, OEM vs aftermarket options, and warranty status

aioInputs.name: batteryType
aioInputs.description: New OEM / New aftermarket / Remanufactured / Refurbished — drives the largest cost swing

aioInputs.name: installationType
aioInputs.description: DIY vs shop — shop adds $300–$1,500 labor; DIY requires high-voltage safety knowledge

aioInputs.name: location
aioInputs.description: US state or region — labor rates and shop availability vary significantly by geography

aioInputs.name: warrantyStatus
aioInputs.description: Is the vehicle still under the hybrid battery warranty (typically 8 yr / 100k mi federal minimum)? Yes/No — may eliminate cost entirely

aioOutputs.name: partsCost
aioOutputs.description: Battery pack cost by type (OEM / aftermarket / reman)

aioOutputs.name: warrantyNote
aioOutputs.description: Flag if vehicle likely still covered under federal 8 yr / 100k mi hybrid warranty

aioDisclaimer: Actual quotes vary 20–40% from estimates — get at least two shop quotes and verify whether your vehicle is still under the federally mandated 8-year/100,000-mile hybrid battery warranty before authorizing any work.
